claims.statement: The Post-Dispatch answered a reader that Tom Allen never fought Jem Mace.
claims.excerpt: Tom AJlen never fought Jem Mace.

claims.statement: Tom Allen picked Sullivan, McAuliffe and Dixon to win and backed all three.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen picked Sullivan, MeAuliffe and Dixon to win and backed all three.

notes: Answer to a reader; the text does not say when the picks were made. The Jem Mace fight in the hints is not supported by this text, which says Allen never fought Mace.
